    if done: break

L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def g5(r0,c0):
    return tuple(tuple('B' if L[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def rot(g):
    n=len(g); return tuple(tuple(g[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(n))
def norm(g):
    best=None
    for _ in range(4):
        t=''.join(''.join(r) for r in g); best=t if best is None else min(best,t); g=rot(g)
    return best
P={p:norm(g5(*p)) for p in [(5,23),(5,46),(14,23),(14,46),(23,23),(23,46)]}
st=[norm(g5(52,15+7*i)) for i in range(5)]
print([ [k for k,v in P.items() if v==x] or 'JUNK' for x in st])
